ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Control Act (MLCA) as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations; Company Act Articles 153-1 through 153-5; Regulations Governing the Identification of Beneficial Owners by Companies; Real Estate Securitization Act for REIT licensing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Joint Venture Agreement (equity subscription and shareholder covenants)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in Mainland China; then authenticated by Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) and Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and SEF Verification (functionally equivalent to consular legalization, Taiwan not party to Hague Apostille)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of foreign investor (CN parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), PRC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization and SEF Verification (with ARATS/SEF seal sequence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Owner Identification Statement (form UBO-1) with passport copies of all ultimate owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notarized in Mainland China; authentication through ARATS/SEF

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) PEP list, UN Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN list for USD-denominated wire settlements, and Taiwan domestic civil-military sanctions list. Additional PEP verification against Mainland China government official lists for foreign-investment approval review.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs (National Business and Industry Administration Services Portal), Company Name Pre-Checking System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company name must be in Chinese characters; an English name may be additionally recorded if it matches the Romanized transliteration. For foreign-invested companies, the Chinese name governs legal personality; any English name or transliteration must not conflict with registered trademarks or phonetic resemblance to prohibited tokens.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is rejected, the applicant must file a statutory review request ('shenfu') with the MOEA Commercial Authority within 15 working days, citing the specific objection category. Unsuccessful review may be elevated to an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days, and thereafter to the Taipei High Administrative Court under administrative litigation procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted. A physical registered office in Taiwan is mandatory for the REIT management company or trust. The Real Estate Securitization Act and Investment Commission of the MOEA require the JV company to maintain operational premises, books, and minimum resident staff in Taiwan; virtual office services are not recognized as satisfying the registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 70% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first operating year)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 128, 129, 154, 161, 172, 387 and Regulations on Company Registration; supplemented by the Real Estate Securitization Act (不動產證券化條例) for REIT formation
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA, 經濟部商業發展署); locally via Taiwan Business Registration Service Center
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) and Company Registration Application Form (公司登記申請書)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for limited company; capital contribution may be cash or property, and for REIT purposes the paid-in capital must be fully subscribed and deposited in a bank escrow account pending registration; capital verification report required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the incorporation expenses and preliminary contracts made by the incorporators are ratified. That the subscribed shares set out in the Articles of Incorporation are confirmed as fully paid according to the capital verification report. That the registered office of the Company shall be the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation and shall be formally adopted as the principal place of business. That the directors and officers named in the incorporation docket are hereby elected and appointed for the terms provided; the Chairperson and the General Manager are authorized to execute all contracts, open bank accounts, and file the registration application with the competent authority. All actions so taken are approved and ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Pre-Approval and Exclusive Use Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Business Registration One-Stop Portal (申請公司名稱及所營事業登記預查)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed Chinese and English company names together with the business scope codes for the REIT operation. The national name pre-approval system checks conflicts and prohibited words. After approval, the name reservation is valid for six months and may be renewed once.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a new pre-approval application with an alternate name; request administrative reconsideration or appeal to MOEA upon rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Notary Public Office in the jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation and related resolutions in Chinese. The articles must include shareholders, capital amount, business scope (real estate investment trust), share classes, director and supervisor provisions, profit distribution, and registered office address. Each subscriber and incorporator must sign; the document is notarized by a local notary public.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the rejected clauses and re-notarize; request the notary to issue a formal explanation if the objection is technical.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Subscription, Bank Escrow, and Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank with branch in Taiwan and registered CPA (會計師)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the company name under formation; deposit the full subscribed capital of the REIT entity. Obtain a Certificate of Capital Deposit from the bank. Engage a licensed Taiwan CPA to issue a capital verification report (資本額查核報告書) confirming legal receipt and no advance withdrawals.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the verification report is queried, provide supplementary bank statements and remittance records; reissue the report through the same CPA or alternate practitioner.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Company Registration Application to MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs via the Taiwan Company Registration Online Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the company registration application attaching the notarized Articles, capital verification report, name approval certificate, and director/statutory supervisor consent forms. Pay the filing fee online. The authority examines the application and issues the Company Registration Certificate within the statutory service period.
required_dossiers: Directors and supervisors identification and consent forms
Registered office lease or ownership proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to MOEA's deficiency notice within fifteen days by submitting corrected documents; request an extension if notarization is pending; re-file after curing the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organization Setup, Officer Appointment, and Corporate Seal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs; local municipal registration office; bank corporate account management
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration approval, convene the First Board Meeting to elect or confirm the chairperson, the general manager, and the corporate legal representative. Adopt the common seal and company seal resolutions; register the corporate seal and representative in the national corporate database. Open a corporate bank account and record the Company Registration Certificate number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the company seal registration is rejected, resubmit with a notarized copy of the board minutes and a statement from the registered legal representative.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC, 金融監督管理委員會) and Securities and Futures Bureau (證券期貨局)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Real Estate Investment Trust Approval and Public Offering / Private Placement Registration (不動產投資信託核准或申報生效)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration, Executive Yuan (行政院環境保護署) / Ministry of Environment (環境部)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B-2 registration for small-scale building rental/management projects; full EIA Report only when the REIT undertakes new development exceeding the threshold of 1 hectare or construction floor area above 5,000 square meters
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with effluent standards for wastewater (suspended solids ≤ 30 mg/L, BOD ≤ 30 mg/L), volatile organic compounds (VOCs) control under air pollution permit, and hazardous waste handling in accordance with Taiwan Waste Disposal Act and Category E waste requirements

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from local Fire Bureau; building structural load inspection and occupancy use license from the local Public Works Department; occupational safety and health inspection for regulated workplaces; commercial elevator and escalator inspection certificates by recognized certifying bodies.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance (財政部, MOF); regional National Taxation Bureaus (各地區國稅局) administer profit-seeking enterprise income tax, Business Tax (VAT) and e-invoice compliance; online services via the Tax Portal (財政部稅務入口網, etax.nat.gov.tw) and the E-Invoice Integration Platform (電子發票整合服務平台, einv.nat.gov.tw).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: obtain Foreign Investment Approval from the MOEA Investment Commission; Step 2: incorporate the Taiwan company (股份有限公司) under the Company Act via MOEA Company Registration (公司登記); Step 3: secure Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) approval for the REIT under the Real Estate Securitization Act; Step 4: file profit-seeking enterprise income tax and Business Tax registration with the competent National Taxation Bureau within 15 days of business commencement to obtain the Unified Business Number (統一編號, GUI) and VAT registration certificate; Step 5: register for Cloud E-Invoice (電子發票) and obtain the MOEA company digital certificate (工商憑證) for e-filing and Turnkey transmission.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: REIT pass-through distribution election: distributed REIT trust income is taxable at the beneficiary level by withholding at source, leaving the REIT entity untaxed on distributed income; undistributed trust income remains taxable at entity level at the 20% profit-seeking enterprise income tax rate. VAT filing-frequency election: monthly VAT filing may be elected instead of the standard bi-monthly filing to accelerate input VAT refunds on zero-rated export transactions. Taiwan has no US-style 'check-the-box' election; entity classification is fixed by company law and the Real Estate Securitization Act, and hybrid mismatch avoidance is effected through the CFC rules (Income Tax Act Article 43-3) and PEM rules (Article 43-4).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax (加值型及非加值型營業稅), a VAT-style consumption tax with creditable input tax ('Business Tax')
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Corporate entities must register for VAT within 15 days of business commencement with no turnover threshold; simplified-tier registration applies above NT$80,000 (goods) / NT$40,000 (services) average monthly sales; full VAT and Uniform Invoice (統一發票) registration becomes compulsory once average monthly sales exceed NT$200,000. A REIT vehicle earning Taiwanese real estate rental and management income is therefore mandatorily VAT-registered from inception.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Enterprises with average monthly sales above NT$200,000 must issue Uniform Invoices, predominantly in Cloud E-Invoice (電子發票) form; invoice XML data must be transmitted via the MOF 'Turnkey' (t-k) gateway to the E-Invoice Integration Platform within 48 hours of issuance for both B2B and B2C transactions, with digital validation through a unique invoice number, random code (隨機碼) and QR code/2D barcode printed on the e-invoice proof (電子發票證明聯). The MOF platform performs central clearing, cross-matching and Uniform Invoice lottery validation; no separate physical fiscal safe or real-time stamping hardware is mandated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 7 of the Business Tax Act, 0% VAT applies to: (i) goods exported from Taiwan customs territory; (ii) goods sold to bonded export zones or offshore clients; (iii) services supplied for use entirely outside Taiwan or rendered overseas; and (iv) international transport services. A Taiwan REIT may claim zero-rating only for rental or property-management income sourced from real estate located outside Taiwan or for services rendered to non-resident principals for offshore use; income from Taiwan real estate (lease and management fees) is taxable at the standard 5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口報單) or approved customs export clearance record
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (提單或航空貨運單) evidencing physical export
Commercial Invoice and Packing List (商業發票及裝箱單)
Export proceeds settlement certificate or foreign-currency inward remittance certificate (出口結匯水單或外匯收入證明)
Executed sales contract or service agreement with the non-resident counterparty
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating is denied where export documentation or foreign-exchange settlement is incomplete or inconsistent: the 5% VAT is retroactively assessed with interest, and a penalty of up to five times the evaded tax is imposed under the Business Tax Act; the statutory assessment period extends to seven years for under-reported VAT. Willful evasion carries criminal liability under the Tax Collection Act (imprisonment up to five years); repeated false claims trigger enhanced audit status, invoice-issuance restrictions, suspension of e-invoice/refund privileges, and Customs penalties for false or fabricated export declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) (中央銀行, CBC), acting jointly with the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) for REIT licensing and with the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) for mainland-China capital admission
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The New Taiwan Dollar (TWD) is fully convertible for current-account trade and service transactions, requiring settlement through a Designated Foreign Exchange Bank (指定外匯銀行) with supporting commercial documents; no CBC pre-approval applies to trade remittances. Capital-account convertibility is residence-based and quota-controlled: CBC places an annual net settlement ceiling of USD 5,000,000 per natural person and USD 50,000,000 per corporate entity for transactions without individual CBC sanction; amounts above these thresholds require CBC approval. For a mainland-China-funded JV, the Act for Relations between the People of Taiwan and the Mainland Area (台灣地區與大陸地區人民關係條例) and the Rules Governing Investment in Taiwan by Mainland-Area People (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法) impose an additional pre-clearance requirement: the MOEA Investment Commission must approve the initial inward equity investment, any capital increase, the approved business scope, and the shareholding structure. Profit repatriation is permitted only after the commission's pre-registration, tax clearance by the National Taxation Bureau, and physical verification of the approval letter by the remitting bank. REIT distributions to non-resident beneficiaries are treated as trust income under the Income Tax Act; a 15-20% withholding is applied depending on the treaty or Taiwan's statutory domestic withholding rate, and the CBC declaration threshold (USD 500,000 per remittance or 20 aggregated remittances per year) always applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Taiwan has abolished mandatory export-proceeds surrender; an exporter is not required to convert foreign currency receipts into TWD but must repatriate all export receivables within the payment terms declared to Customs at export (30-180 days for D/A, D/P, and O/A arrangements) and must settle the collection exclusively through a Designated Foreign Exchange Bank to allow CBC cross-verification against the export declaration. The exporter may retain the collected FX in a domestic foreign-currency deposit account. Each export settlement on the Forex Declaration Form (外匯收支或交易申報書) is mandatory where the amount equals or exceeds USD 500,000. For the REIT itself, rental income arises in TWD domestically and therefore attracts no surrender or repatriation obligation; the applicable obligation is only on the JV sponsor's trading revenue if any export activity is later appended to the approved business scope.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Taiwan does not issue an offshore EMI license; the Electronic Payment Institution Act (電子支付機構管理條例) regulates domestic e-payment warehousing, not cross-border corporate treasury. No offshore digital bank (e.g., Revolut, Wise) can hold TWD clearing accounts or access the Taiwan Clearing House (台灣票據交換所) or the CBC interbank transfer system (CIFS). An offshore EMI may function only as an upstream USD/EUR float vehicle for pre-funding the Taiwan FX spread, with settlement completed via correspondent bank SWIFT MT103 into an onshore designated FX bank; this introduces dual AML/KYC checks and surplus economic cost. For a regulated REIT with mandatory FSC-governed trust accounts, use of an offshore EMI as the primary treasury rail is not legally viable. The recommended architecture is a direct account at a tier-1 Taiwan clearing bank with a separate USD reserve account at a correspondent bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical appearance. CBC and FSC anti-money-laundering regulations (Banking Act Article 7 and Financial Supervisory Commission AML Guidance for Banks) require for corporate account onboarding a face-to-face interview with the responsible person, ultimate beneficial owner(s), and each authorized signatory. Taiwanese tier-1 banks universally reject pure remote opening for a mainland-China-funded JV because of the enhanced scrutiny established by the Act for Relations; video KYC (via the bank's designated app) is allowed only after a physical visit is completed by either the local general manager or the mainland parent's authorized director. The mainland responsible person's physical appearance at a Taiwan branch may alternatively be substituted by an in-person procedure at a Taiwan Economic and Cultural Office (TECO) or another CBC-recognized overseas verification point, but in practice for a real-estate REIT the signed board resolution, the seal registration with the company registrar, and the passport/tax-ID presentation are executed onshore.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership traceable to a mainland-China parent; bank compliance must classify the entity as a mainland-invested (陸資) account under the Act for Relations, immediately elevating the risk to sanctioned-party-screening and PEP-adjacent controls.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MOEA Investment Commission approval letter for mainland investment; certificate of company incorporation and last amendment filing; CPA-issued capital verification report; chain-of-ownership chart listing all ultimate natural persons; audited financial statements of the mainland parent for two years; a sanctions-screening legal opinion confirming the company and its shareholders are not on UN, OFAC, EU, or Taiwan consolidated sanction lists; a bank-format declaration of source of funds for the initial capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: REIT statutory license and trust-account purpose cannot be verified by the underwriting team, generating an unstructured-account red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FSC permit issued under Article 9 of the Real Estate Securitization Act (不動產證券化條例); executed REIT trust deed (信託契約) identifying the trustee bank and beneficial-interest holders; FSC-approved offering prospectus; title deeds and property appraisal certificates for each underlying income-generating real estate asset; the trustee bank's fiduciary acceptance letter; schedule of the initial five-year revenue forecast and rental roll.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fund-flow velocity and circularity: nightly sweeping of tenant rental collections from the REIT operating account to the sponsor and periodic distribution wires to mainland beneficiaries could be mischaracterized as money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury funds-flow matrix validated by the JV CFO and trustee; executed tenant leases; property management outsourcing agreement; source-of-funds declaration matched to the certified rent roll; formal board resolution setting the distribution policy and sweep schedule; written commitment to file CBC Forex Declaration Forms for every distribution wire and to maintain STR procedures under the Money Laundering Control Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face and cross-border identity gap: signatories resident in mainland China cannot present an ARC or Taiwan passport, and their foreign ID lacks verifiable local notarization.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: In-person branch appointment and biometric capture for the Taiwan resident manager; board resolution appointing authorized signatories with specimen signatures and company chop; notarization of the mainland parent director's ID by the People's Notary Office and further legalization through the Straits Exchange Foundation (海峽交流基金會) authentication route; bank-specific video KYC supplementary interview with timestamps; audited identity dossier retained in line with CBC's five-year document-retention rule.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire protocol: (1) MOEA Investment Commission permit for formation or capital increase; (2) remittance from the mainland parent's bank via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for a pre-funded intermediate bank) to the designated FX bank in Taiwan with the settlement instruction identifying the beneficiary as the JV's capital escrow account; (3) bank completion of the CBC Foreign Exchange Declaration Form citing purpose code 'Inward Investment Remittance - Equity Subscription (投資股本匯入)' and quoting the MOEA approval number; (4) TWD conversion at the designated bank's buying rate recorded on the CBC foreign-exchange transaction system; (5) issuance of a bank foreign-exchange transaction memorandum as evidence for the CPA capital verification; and (6) registration of the paid-in capital with the Ministry of Economic Affairs after submission of the final equity allocation statement. All underlying contracts, valuations, and board minutes for the underlying Taiwan property portfolio must be uploaded to the bank's compliance portal before execution; the CBC retains the right to re-settle any suspicious transaction above the USD 500,000 reporting threshold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury rails: (a) Dividend and REIT beneficial-interest distributions: executed only through SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'Outward Investment Income Remittance (投資收益匯出)'; the remittance file must append the CPA audited statutory financial statements, the withholding tax payment voucher (15% for corporate beneficiaries, 20% for individual beneficiaries absent a reduction under a tax treaty), the MOEA Investment Commission's record of return, and the CBC Forex Declaration Form. (b) Trade settlement for property construction and fit-out: UCP600-compliant Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) issued through the designated FX bank with the corresponding shipping/acceptance documents, or direct supplier MT103 payments tagged with an import/export license number when the underlying is machinery; RMB-denominated supplier settlements are lawful via the Taiwan subsidiary's designated FX bank using the TWD/CNY offshore clearing window operated by the Taiwan Clearing House. (c) REIT asset-level cash distributions: TWD rents are pooled in the trust account and converted to USD/CNY through one designated bank using a deliverable FX forward matched to the distribution declaration dates; each distribution batch remains subject to the corporate USD 50,000,000 annual net settlement ceiling, and breach of this ceiling requires a CBC prior-approval letter.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (遠期外匯) booked onshore with a designated FX bank, backed by the executed REIT distribution schedule or verified CAPEX payables; tenor strictly limited to the maturity of the underlying real cash-flow exposure.
Cross-Currency Swaps (CCS / 換匯換利) between TWD and USD where the REIT's rental cash flows are TWD-denominated and the mandated dividend leg to foreign beneficial-interest holders is USD-denominated.
FX Currency Swaps (換匯交易) for bridging CNY share capital to USD dividend obligations without an uncovered forward position.

Vanilla Physical-Settlement FX Options (買權/賣權) quoted by the designated FX bank for committed distribution dates, with premium paid from the operational account and exercised only to hedge an actual foreign-currency payment.

Prohibited instruments: NDFs (Non-Deliverable Forwards) and all offshore TWD forwards referencing the offshore CNY/TWD spread are banned for onshore Taiwanese corporates; the CBC has prohibited domestic corporate access to the NDF market since 1998 and will void uncovered or speculative transactions, imposing administrative fines and suspension of the bank's FX authorization.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Report, Financial Statements, and Profit-Distribution Proposal – Approval by Shareholders and Filing with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Commercial Administration and Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual shareholders' meeting to be held within 6 months after fiscal year end (by 30 June for a calendar-year company); filing to MOEA within 20 days after the meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under Taiwan Companies Act Arts. 230 and 387, a fine of NT$10,000–50,000 may be imposed on the responsible person for failure to file; repeated noncompliance can lead to compulsory filing orders and, ultimately, dissolution by the central competent authority.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Mainland vs. Foreign-Invested Enterprise Business Operation Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 30 June each year for the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Noncompliance under the Foreign Investment Act and cross-strait investment provisions may result in fines, restriction of capital remittances, and possible revocation of the investment approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual REIT Financial Report, Audit Report, and Real Estate Valuation Update filed with the Financial Supervisory Commission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) – Securities and Futures Bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year end (by 30 April for a calendar-year REIT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under the Real Estate Securitization Act and related FSC rules, failure to file or publishing materially deficient information can lead to corrective orders, public reprimand, fines up to NT$1.5 million, and in severe cases suspension or revocation of the REIT license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return with Attached Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (local competent tax office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing period from 1 May through 31 May (or approved extension to 30 June) after fiscal year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 2% per month on the unpaid tax up to 20%, plus interest; failure to file after a tax-office notice may attract additional penalties and tax-on-verification under the Tax Collection Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Taiwan Companies Act Art. 20 and the MOEA threshold, a private company with paid-in capital of NT$30,000,000 or more (approx. USD 950,000) must have annual financial statements audited and certified by a Taiwanese CPA; FSC-licensed REITs require a mandatory CPA audit irrespective of capital size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as endorsed by the FSC for public offering and FSC-regulated issuers; non-public companies may apply Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TIFRS/Gaap) which are largely converged with IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not require a standalone annual UBO return for private JVs, but the company must update its substantial-controller records (including shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners) during the annual shareholders' meeting cycle and whenever share transfers occur; a mainland-invested JV must also report ownership changes to the Investment Commission. For an FSC-licensed REIT, the trustee manager must annually confirm beneficial holder information within the annual compliance report to the FSC.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600–1,200 per year for a Taiwan registered office and licensed corporate secretary; additional USD 300–600 for annual statutory record and minute book maintenance.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 8,000–25,000 typical for an FSC-regulated REIT with CPA audit and valuation review; smaller private JV audits may range USD 3,000–6,000 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: REIT flow-through exemption: distributed income exempt at trust level; undistributed earnings surtax 5%; no general tax holiday
